subject: Shared Onboarding Playbook: timeline, owners, and escalation triggers
messages:
From: Marcy Collins <marcy.collins@brightlinehealth.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood-inference.com
Cc: it-admin@brightlinehealth.com
Date: Fri, 21 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Shared playbook / kickoff request

Hi Jonas,

Thanks again for today's demo — the team was impressed with the inference latency and the dedicated capacity options. Attached is our rough MAP (BRIGHTLINE_MAP_v1) and the SOW template the procurement team prefers.

High level asks from BrightLine:
- We need a 6-week implementation horizon with clearly owned milestones (security questionnaire, IP allowlist, staging ingest, dry-run, and go-live).
- A single RACI for the first 30 days and a pre-approved fallback model if the quantized variant introduces quality regression.
- Procurement needs a target date for signature to align budgets (we're aiming for the end of June).

Can your team propose an owners-and-dates slate by EOD Monday? I can loop in procurement and IT if helpful.

Attachments: BRIGHTLINE_MAP_v1.xlsx; SOW_template_BrightLine.pdf

Thanks,
Marcy Collins
Director, Product Operations
BrightLine Health
From: jonas_weber@redwood-inference.com
To: Marcy Collins <marcy.collins@brightlinehealth.com>
Cc: camila_reyes@redwood-inference.com, neha_kapoor@redwood-inference.com, ben_carter@redwood-inference.com
Date: Fri, 21 May 2026 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Shared playbook / kickoff request

Marcy —

Appreciate the notes and the MAP; I've sketched a pragmatic 6-week plan below and attached a one-page owners grid (BRIGHTLINE_MAP_v2.xlsx). High-level version here: 

Week 0 (prep, owner alignment) — target: 2026-05-24
- Redwood: Jonas (program lead) — finalize kickoff agenda, share staging checklist
- BrightLine: Marcy (product ops) — confirm integration contacts and procurement timelines

Week 1 (security & infra) — 2026-05-25 to 2026-05-31
- Redwood: Camila — run security review, provide evidence (SOC2 artifacts, network diagrams)
- BrightLine: IT — provide IP ranges for allowlist and staging VPC peering request

Week 2-3 (integration & ingest) — 2026-06-01 to 2026-06-14
- Redwood: Camila + Engs — API contract, sample payloads, staging endpoint
- BrightLine: Engs — data slices and performance targets for 10k tokens/day load test

Week 4 (dry-run & quality validation) — 2026-06-15 to 2026-06-21
- Owners run end-to-end dry-run; define acceptance criteria (latency P50/P95, quality threshold)

Week 5-6 (cutover & hypercare) — target go-live week 2026-06-28
- Redwood: Ben — lead cutover and monitoring; Jonas runs post-go-live cadence
- BrightLine: Marcy — customer-side readiness and training

Escalation triggers: failed dry-run (auto rollback to hosted-compatible model), unresolved security open item >72h (exec escalation to both VP Ops).

Action items for Monday EOD:
1) Marcy — confirm procurement signature target and whether June 28 is acceptable for go-live.
2) BrightLine IT — send allowlist ranges and point of contact for peering.
3) Camila/Redwood — we will circulate a shortened security evidence pack by Monday.

I've attached BRIGHTLINE_MAP_v2.xlsx (owners grid + dates) and an edited SOW draft (SOW_draft_BrightLine_20260521.pdf). If that looks good we can create a DocuSign envelope for procurement next week.

—Jonas
Jonas Weber
Senior Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
From: camila_reyes@redwood-inference.com
To: Jon as We ber <jonas_weber@redwood-inference.com>, Marcy Collins <marcy.collins@brightlinehealth.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood-inference.com, ben_carter@redwood-inference.com
Date: Mon, 24 May 2026 08:36:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Shared playbook / kickoff request

On Fri, May 21, 2026 at 11:04 AM jonas_weber@redwood-inference.com wrote:
> Marcy —
> 
> Appreciate the notes and the MAP; I've sketched a pragmatic 6-week plan below and attached a one-page owners grid (BRIGHTLINE_MAP_v2.xlsx). High-level version here: 

Thanks — quick technical clarifications so BrightLine's engineers can schedule work:
- For staging we'll provide a preprod API endpoint (mTLS optional) and a short-lived API key for validation. If BrightLine requires VPC peering, we'll need the CIDR and an AWS account ID; peering approval typically takes 48–72 hours.
- Data ingestion: please confirm max payload size and expected concurrency. We recommend starting with 2 concurrent streams for the dry-run and ramp to 8 during load tests.
- Quantization fallback: we'll include a 1:1 quality checkset for your top 200 prompts; if the quantized model drops below 95% pass-rate versus baseline we'll hold cutover and propose either a higher-precision profile or additional prompt filters.

Attachments referenced: BRIGHTLINE_MAP_v2.xlsx (owners grid); SOW_draft_BrightLine_20260521.pdf

I'll compile a short tech onboarding packet and a JIRA project template by EOD Tuesday.

- Camila
Camila Reyes
Principal Engineer, Integrations | Redwood Inference
From: Marcy Collins <marcy.collins@brightlinehealth.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood-inference.com
Cc: it-admin@brightlinehealth.com, camila_reyes@redwood-inference.com, neha_kapoor@redwood-inference.com
Date: Mon, 24 May 2026 15:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Shared playbook / kickoff request

Jonas / team — thanks for the rapid turnaround and the owners grid. Procurement can sign the SOW the week of 6/21 if we have the final DocuSign by 6/14; that's our constraint to meet the internal fiscal cutover. IT will send the CIDR and an initial list of test payloads tomorrow morning.

Confirming next steps: 
- BrightLine: procurement to accept DocuSign by 2026-06-14 (target)
- Redwood: prepare DocuSign envelope and starter security evidence pack by 2026-06-07
- Tech: Camila and BrightLine IT to exchange allowlist/CIDR and run initial connectivity test 2026-05-27

We are good to proceed on your proposed timeline — please add a procurement milestone to the MAP (signature by 6/14). I'll also add Marcy.m@brightline to the HubSpot deal record.

Best,
Marcy
